content.text: Here is the complete audit of `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Zip-Code/extensions/zip-code-widget/blocks/zip-code-checker.liquid`. --- ## Audit Results ### 1. Remaining Emojis / Unicode Symbols No emoji characters remain anywhere in the file. All visual elements use SVG icons. The only Unicode escapes present are: - Line 172: `\u2019` — a right single quotation mark (typographic apostrophe in "don\u2019t"). This is correct typography, not a visual icon. - Line 491: `\u2026` — horizontal ellipsis in the loading button label "Submitting\u2026". This is a text character used as a label suffix, not an emoji. - Line 536: `\u00b7` — middle dot used as a separator between delivery days (e.g. "Mon · Wed · Fri"). Typographic separator, not an emoji. - Line 600: `\u2026` in the social proof text — wait, actually line 600 is `' Join ' + count + ' other' + ...` with no Unicode escape. That is clean. - Line 696: `'Submitting\u2026'` — ellipsis, same as above. Fine. All clean on emojis. --- ### 2. "CHECK X" Button — Reset/Clear Icon There is no "X" button on the input field at all. The widget does not implement any clear/reset input icon. The button shows: - Default state: search icon + button text (lines 463–465) - Loading state: spinner icon + ellipsis text (lines 489–490) - After result: it resets back to search icon + `cfg.buttonText` (lines 492–494) There is no state where the button shows a text "X". The user's concern about "CHECK X" is not present — but there is also no per-result "clear/reset" affordance. After a ZIP check returns a result (success or failure), the button reverts to the search icon + original label. If the intent was for the button to show a reset-to-clear icon after a result is displayed, that functionality is absent entirely. --- ### 3. Delivery Timeline (ORDER → SHIPS → DELIVER) There is no ORDER → SHIPS → DELIVER timeline component anywhere in the file. The file renders delivery info as individual metadata rows (`zcc-meta` divs) with truck, calendar, and clock icons. No timeline/stepper UI exists. If this was a feature that was supposed to be in the widget, it is not present. --- ### 4. Social Proof Text Line 600: `' Join ' + count + ' other' + (count !== 1 ? 's' : '') + ' waiting for delivery to your area'` The SVG icon used is `ICONS.users` (a people/group icon, line 599). No emoji. Clean. One spacing note: on line 600, the text node starts with a space character (` Join ...`). This creates a small gap between the SVG icon and the text, which is intentional since the parent flex container already has `gap:6px` set in the CSS (line 380). The extra leading space on the text node doubles the visual gap between icon and text — it will look slightly wider than expected. This is a minor cosmetic issue but not a bug per se. --- ### 5. COD Available Badge Lines 548–551: ``` ICONS.card + ' Cash on Delivery Available' ICONS.card + ' COD Not Available' ``` The icon is `ICONS.card` (a credit/payment card SVG, line 437). No emoji. Clean. One issue here: The `ICONS.card` SVG is inserted directly adjacent to the text string with a space (`ICONS.card + ' Cash on...'`). This places the SVG and text as raw HTML siblings inside the `zcc-cod` flex container. The CSS sets `gap:5px` on `.zcc-cod` (line 355), so the flex gap handles spacing. However, there is a literal space character between the SVG and the text label in the HTML string. Inside a flex container this space renders as a text node with ~0 visual width (collapsed), so it is harmless — but it is inconsistent with how other icons are wrapped in `` containers. Not a bug, just inconsistency. --- ### 6. Returns Accepted Line 553: `ICONS.refresh + '' + esc(data.returnPolicy) + ''` The icon is `ICONS.refresh` (a circular arrow SVG, line 438). No emoji. Clean. --- ### 7. Loading Spinner Animation Line 441: ``` spinner: '' ``` The `@keyframes zcc-spin` is defined at line 335 in `buildSharedCss`. However, the spinner SVG has `style="animation:zcc-spin 0.8s linear infinite"` hardcoded inline. This style is set at the time the ICONS object is defined (line 441), which is before `buildSharedCss` is called. The keyframe `zcc-spin` is only injected when `injectCss` is called (which calls `buildWidgetCss` which calls `buildSharedCss`). The ICONS object is a module-level constant — this is fine because the spinner is only ever inserted into the DOM after `wireWidget` is called, which happens after `injectCss`. So the keyframe will always be present before the spinner appears. The animation will work correctly. --- ### 8. Spacing / CSS Issues **buildSharedCss (lines 332–386):** - Line 346: `.zcc-meta` has `gap:7px`. Line 351: `.zcc-cutoff` has `gap:7px`. Line 352: `.zcc-days` has `gap:7px`. Line 360: `.zcc-return-policy` has `gap:7px`. These are all consistent. - Line 380: `.zcc-social-proof` has `gap:6px` and `margin-bottom:10px`. This is correct for a pill that appears above the waitlist form inputs. - The `@keyframes zcc-spin` is declared at line 335, and `@keyframes zcc-pulse` at line 384. Both are inside `buildSharedCss`. The `zcc-pulse` animation is used on the floating trigger button (line 769) — that CSS is injected separately in `buildFloatingCss` style block (line 747), not via `buildSharedCss`. However, `buildSharedCss` is always called via `buildWidgetCss`, which is always called via `injectCss`, which is always called before the floating panel is built. So `zcc-pulse` will be available. Fine. **buildWidgetCss (lines 389–417):** - Line 399: `.zcc-search-bar` uses `gap:10px` and `flex-direction:row`. Input and button are siblings in a row. Fine. - Line 400: `.zcc-input` has `padding:12px 16px`. Line 403: `.zcc-btn` has `padding:12px 24px`. Vertical padding matches — the input and button will be the same height. Good. - Line 407: `.zcc-result` has `margin-top:12px`. The heading bottom border/margin is `margin-bottom:12px` (line 396). So the gap between the search bar and result is 12px — consistent. **One actual spacing inconsistency found:** Line 396: `.zcc-heading` has `padding-bottom:12px` AND `margin-bottom:12px`. This means the heading has 12px of padding below its text, then a 1px border, then 12px of margin below the border, before the search bar starts. Total visual gap from heading text baseline to input top is approximately 24–25px. This is intentional (border separator + breathing room) but is noticeably larger than the 12px gap between the search bar and result card. Whether this is desired or a spacing inconsistency is a judgment call, but it is the only notable discrepancy. --- ### 9. The `data.waitlistCount` Social Proof Injection Point Lines 591–604: The social proof element is injected `insertBefore` the `wlSection` (which is the name input, `wid + "-wl-name"`), but only when `wlForm.style.display !== "none"`. Actually — looking more carefully: the social proof is wired at the same time as the waitlist toggle, before the form is shown (the form is hidden by default). The social proof is inserted into `wlSection.parentNode` — the `wlForm` div — even while `wlForm.style.display === "none"`. When the user clicks the toggle to show the form, the social proof pill will appear above the name input. This logic is correct. However: the social proof is inserted unconditionally when `data.waitlistCount > 0`, regardless of whether the user has already toggled open the form. If the user checks another ZIP code after seeing the form, and gets another failure, a second social proof pill could be injected. This is a pre-existing logic concern, not introduced by the SVG migration. --- ## Summary **The widget is clean of emojis.** All visual icons are SVGs from the `ICONS` object or inline SVGs. No Unicode emoji codepoints are present. **Issues to be aware of (not introduced by the SVG migration, but present):** 1. **Line 600** — Extra leading space in the social proof text node creates a slightly doubled visual gap between the users SVG icon and text (minor cosmetic, gap:6px + space char). 2. **No reset/clear button on the input** — The "CHECK X" scenario the user asked about does not exist because there is no reset affordance after a result is shown. The button always reverts to the search icon. If a dedicated X/reset icon was intended for the button in the error state, it has not been implemented. 3. **No ORDER → SHIPS → DELIVER timeline** — This component does not exist in the widget at all. 4. **Line 396** — Heading has both `padding-bottom:12px` and `margin-bottom:12px`, creating ~25px total gap before the search bar vs the 12px gap used elsewhere. Intentional or oversight. 5. **Lines 548/549** — COD badge injects the card SVG directly as a string sibling (not wrapped in a span), inconsistent with the icon-wrapping pattern used elsewhere, but visually functional.
